summary.text: Drew Cranmer is a data engineer and small-business founder from Wichita running as the Libertarian Party candidate for Kansas's 4th District. He describes himself as not a career politician and is running on restoring Congress's constitutional war and spending powers and devolving policy to the states.

paragraphs.text: Cranmer describes himself as a data engineer, small-business founder, husband and father from Wichita. He says he has spent his career building data pipelines and software, and that he has investigated warrantless license plate surveillance in his community.
